The receipt email now sits behind `NOTIFIER_FF_NEW_RECEIPT_EMAIL`, but there was no "new receipt email" in the repo, so I made one up. Both notifier tests pass.

- **Flag:** it follows the notifier convention of `NOTIFIER_FF_<NAME>` with value `"1"`. The notifier can't read the root `flags.toml`, so `flags.is_on()` doesn't apply here. With the flag unset, `send_receipt` in `services/notifier/notifier/email.py` renders the existing `receipt` template as before. With it set to `"1"`, it renders `receipt_v2`.
- **Templates:** `services/notifier/templates/` didn't exist, so I created `receipt_v2.mjml` and a plain-text twin `receipt_v2.txt`, as the template convention requires. The copy in them is placeholder text I wrote. Please replace it with the real design. The notifier is owned by Growth, who sign off template and copy changes in #growth-eng.
- **Tests:** I added one test that checks the flag selects `receipt_v2`. The existing test still covers the flag-off path.
- **Rollout:** the flag is a plain environment variable on the deployed function, so turning it on gradually means setting it per environment. It can't give a percentage-based rollout. That would need extra logic, for example hashing the invoice id.

`render()` is still a `NotImplementedError` stub, so none of this actually sends yet.
